_comment: Phase-Z1 ZH eval set (plan_zh.md Z3 readout 3). Same 20 ids as ja_eval_prompts.json / ko_eval_prompts.json; `en` is copied verbatim (teacher side identical). `zh` is the wording a mainland Chinese user would type (NGA / Bilibili prompt register, simplified), not textbook translation. Per-row register decisions: 1girl -> '1个女性' (the NGA pack's own wording, chosen over latin '1girl' so the row exercises ext rows), looking at viewer -> '看向观众', twintails -> '双马尾', armor -> '盔甲', cape -> '披风', maid -> '女仆', hoodie -> '连帽衫', depth of field -> '景深', from above -> '俯视', wide shot -> '远景', monochrome -> '单色'. Tag rows join with ', '; prose rows use Chinese full-width commas '，' (an ext row, like JA 、) and Chinese double quotes “ ”. Drafted by the agent 2026-09-02 — needs the r1 native review before any number read on it is quoted.
